clauses.reason: The batch's own record exists from batch-open, and the attribution rule is also checked when each batch commit is made.

updates.rationale: Batch-owned fixes keep combination repairs reviewable without letting unattributed work reach delivery, and a refusal at commit time prevents a batch from becoming permanently unfinalizable.
updates.statement: A defect that appears only when members combine may be fixed by commits made directly in the batch under the batch's own approved change record, approval before implementation and journaled, and is validated by the next final. batch-open writes that record as an unapproved draft excluded from Git status, so an unused draft is never delivered. A member-owned defect is fixed in its member and re-admitted. Final refuses a first-parent non-merge batch commit that changes paths outside change records and decisions unless an approved batch-owned change precedes it, and its review attributes each such commit to those changes; the commit check refuses the same commit when it is made. Merge-conflict resolution is unchanged. After a failed final, status names both repairs.

clauses.reason: Approval order is enforced where the commit is made, by the predicate final and ready already apply.

updates.rationale: One rule checked earlier cannot disagree with final, and refusing before the ref moves leaves nothing to rewrite.
updates.statement: workspace-open and batch-open install a reference-transaction hook in the effective hooks directory unless a foreign hook of that name exists or the directory lies in a worktree, which they report. For a new single-parent commit on the tip of a registered workspace branch, the hook applies to that one commit the approval-order verdict final applies to batch commits and ready applies to member commits, through the same function, and refuses an implementation commit that no committed approval of the workspace's own change record precedes, naming the remedy. Records-only commits, merges, branch creation and deletion and other refs pass. A missing engine warns and passes; final and ready remain the backstop.

clauses.reason: Abandonment failed when run from another repository, and agents were unsure whether they may run it after the owner confirmed.

updates.rationale: One confirmed, recorded removal covers every leftover the guard keeps agents from deleting with raw Git; the owner's confirmation, not who types the command, authorizes it.
updates.statement: maintenance workspace-abandon removes a checkout, registered as a workspace or not, that proves neither delivered nor contained, and maintenance branch-abandon removes a local branch without a checkout that the delivery branch does not contain, only when given the exact current tip the owner confirmed, the owner's identity, the confirmation source and a reason; the retirement record keeps them with the tip. An Agent may run either itself, citing in --source where the owner confirmed that tip; it never infers a confirmation. workspace-abandon takes the repository from the named checkout. maintenance leftovers lists such checkouts and branches read-only. Removal refuses the delivery branch and checkout, open Git operations and staged changes, and discards other uncommitted work only with --discard. These are the only removals for undelivered work; batch-discard is removed.

decisions.reason: In PyReduce a batch fix committed before its approval was found only at final, where the batch could never pass again because history bound by journals is not rewritten. Checking the same predicate when the commit is made turns a permanent failure into a refused commit the agent repairs in seconds. A reference-transaction hook sees the actual commit object, is not skipped by commit --no-verify and does not collide with pre-commit hooks that projects already install; Git older than 2.28 keeps only the final backstop. A second, stricter rule was rejected because two rules could disagree. The draft stays uncommitted and excluded so that a batch without a fix delivers no draft and needs no extra step. Reopen if hosts lacking reference-transaction become common or the excluded draft confuses agents in observed use.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved commit-time approval, batch draft and abandonment decisions
